note: Bounded migration-port manifest. One row per durable codec. Each row names its reader, its
migration authority and single call site, its opaque-future policy, any physical-shell axis
orthogonal to the wire version, and its retirement rule.
A historical fixture must be a checked-in literal produced by the exact historical writer or
taken from real save bytes, carrying source commit and SHA-256 provenance. A fixture is never
generated by today's writer: a coupled reader/writer drift would stay green. Any live wire
version without such a fixture is reported as a hard compatibility gap, not filled in.
Census source: audited durable-codec sweep recorded in the Fable 5 design packet.
A hostileFixtures entry is the opposite of a coverage fixture: hand-frozen bytes that the
exact historical writer CANNOT produce, checked in to prove a refusal. It carries SHA-256
provenance recomputed from its checked-in literal and never reduces a hard gap.
A port that names a parseable version-constant declaration must also name its
versionConstantIdentifier, so the census is checked against that declaration and not by
searching the whole file. Ports that cannot are enumerated in the coverage suite.
A nonDurableVersionSites entry is the opposite of a port: a production file whose
wire-version-shaped constant reaches no saved byte. Each entry names the file, the exact
constant, and why nothing persists it, and the census suite verifies all three rather than
trusting the row. A file in neither list still fails the census.
A port may name nestedWithin when its versioned bytes are framed inside another port's
envelope, and durableSite when the write call site proving durability is not the reader.
A nested row still counts its own live versions: one provenance-backed envelope fixture
would close the enclosing port and the nested one together, so the totals are not
independent, but neither is covered today and neither is hidden.
NON-FINAL. The polity wire has landed at v6 so that the old v1-v5 phase byte 6 stays
invalid. This manifest stays non-final until the independent rereview of the polity v6
completion lane is green. The census sweep that follows the polity lane completed the
manifest: 29 production files declaring a wire-version-shaped constant sat outside it,
28 carrying durable wire and one carrying none. The working total is now 49 ports and
111 hard gaps.
Founder-memory and zone-observation revisions brought the census to 50 ports / 114 hard
gaps. The receipt-backed realm Chronicle intent adds port 51. Its v2 legacy payload and v3
current payload have no provenance-backed historical writer fixtures, and no surviving v1
bytes may be invented; the deliberately conservative numbered gap total is therefore 117.

nonDurableVersionSites.reason: Schema-of-XML validation, not a save wire. The value is compared against the Schema attribute of a public XML registry root read from disk at mod load (Core/KingdomXmlSchema.cs:16) and is only ever spelled back into an operator log line at Core/KingdomXmlSchema.cs:25. Nothing writes it: there is no BinaryWriter, no zone property, no game state, and no IPart or IComposite field carrying it, so no saved byte depends on it and a bump can orphan no save.
